name: Dürr–Struyve Minisuperspace D-QE3 Evidence (fixture)

source.scope_note: Section 6 eqs 67-78; WDW operator, guidance RHS, rhoQ/pQ, TQ assembly, FRW volume

regime: homogeneous isotropic minisuperspace toy model; symmetry-reduced quantization, flat spatial chart

conventions.kappa_bar_squared: declared bound parameter (differentiates to 0 as independent quantity; 4πG/3 value asserted, not derived)

premises.statement: R(a,φ) = a²+φ²+1 as expression/1 over declared (a,φ); test input only, not a WDW solution. Second φ-derivative needs no nonzero condition (first-power rule).
S(a,φ) = a·φ as expression/1; RHS partials executed, LHS time evolution not derived.
A(a) = a²+1 as expression/1; amplitude/phase split stipulated, never decomposed from an arbitrary psi.
∂²_φ and (a∂_a)² applied via DIFFERENTIATE-001 with replayed derivations; (a∂_a)² by composition a·∂_a(a·∂_a·), factored form pinned with anti-golden vs a²∂²_a.
ρQ from paper (76) for the test amplitude: kappa²/2·a^-6·W·A^-1 with replayed partials; NEQ(a,0) and NEQ(A,0) conditions preserved.
Q = a³ρQ as a first-class expression/1 artifact with EQ(Q, a³ρQ) relation; dependency checked by Verify, not merely commented.
pQ = -1/3a²·∂_aQ from differentiating Q (never ρQ); quotient via negative-power rule; hand-traced factored golden plus historical wrong-path anti-golden.
T_Q^00 from ρQ, pQ, comoving U^0 (Kronecker selector over inverse lapse), g^00; construction only.
diag(a²,a²,a²) determinant via replayed CANON+SIMPLIFY with bound-variable anti-golden; a³ factor gated on cited a>0; product form preserved (not a^6).
Bounded ansatz-derived projection S = Σ2a·γ·V with replayed CANON+SIMPLIFY evidence; spatial integration and fiducial volume stay represented-only.

Flat FRW spatial h_ij=a²δ_ij in a Cartesian chart: general adjugate inverse (never diagonal shortcut), vanishing Levi-Civita coefficients verified zero, test-covector derivative with Kronecker-delta goldens and covariant_evaluation/1 certificate. Action/direct routes stay distinct; no route claimed verified.

verification.primary_derivation_trace: replayed DIFFERENTIATE/CANON/SIMPLIFY derivations per evidence piece, including the FRW determinant derivation
verification.secondary_verification: Fixture.Verify replays every stored derivation (Derivs plus FRWDerivRef) and checks the Q/density construction relation; hand-derived goldens pin operator composition, quotient expansion, volume provenance, and the historical wrong-pressure rejection

limitations.statement: The WDW residual is computed and recorded, never solved; no ψ satisfying Ĥψ=0 is constructed.
Guidance LHS time derivatives are represented relations; evolution is not derived.
Minisuperspace is the paper's symmetry-reduced toy model, not the full Wheeler-DeWitt theory (general functional derivatives unrepresented).
Only the bounded ansatz-derived projection (2a·γ·V sums) is implemented; general δ/δh_ij(x), δ/δφ(x) remain unsupported; integration stays represented-only.
R^(3), R, and covariant derivatives are represented at most; k enters only as an assumption.
Simplified forms preserve factored structure (no distributivity or x+x→2x); equalities to collapsed monomials are hand-verified in test comments, not executed.
No observational or experimental consequences are represented or claimed.
Covariant evaluation covers the FRW-chart fragment above; general curvature, Bianchi identities, and functional derivatives remain unsupported.
